root_cause: The mobile pricing control was visible and present, but Playwright scrollIntoViewIfNeeded waited for element stability and timed out before any pointer click. The instability was in Playwright's auto-scroll actionability phase, not in the pricing runtime itself.
prevention_rule: For production browser proofs where sticky/responsive layout can keep a visible element moving, use deterministic DOM scrollIntoView to position the target, then preserve a real Playwright pointer click. Never use force:true or DOM click() to manufacture success.

invariants: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded is not used for this mobile proof
force:true and DOM click bypass remain forbidden
